answer_2.quote: We measure the effect of the attacks on rationale generation, we use two metrics: Gold rationale F1 (GR) This is defined as the F1 score between the predicted rationale and a humanannotated rationale ... Attack capture rate (AR) We define AR as the recall of the inserted attack text in the rationale generated by the model ... where f denotes a scoring function (F1 scores in extractive question answering and I(y = ŷ) in text classification).
